interpretation_notes: The proposition is Supported because the evidence establishes material shortfalls in all four specified areas. Range fell significantly short of contracted cold-weather specifications (averaging 165 km vs. 268 km contracted). Reliability and durability failed, with over half the fleet reported out of service and independent evaluations noting mechanical issues and body cracks. Vendor support failed when Edmonton's contract was excluded from Proterra's bankruptcy sale. While the buses provided some ongoing service, the operationalization defines failure as material shortfalls against specifications, which is met. Confidence is Moderate because the exact contractual requirements and Edmonton-specific performance figures rely heavily on untested litigation filings, although union statements and independent transit evaluations corroborate the vehicle model's inherent defects.
